title: KMS/HSM key-federation orchestrator and secrets-routing Terraform module for VPC/private deployments
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers deploying Redwood Private into VPCs need a single, audited Terraform module to wire cloud KMS and on-prem HSMs to our secrets mesh (Vault/Secrets Manager). Current internal modules are fragmented: some teams use a Vault-only flow, others dual-write to cloud KMS. This causes inconsistent rotations, unreliable failover, and gaps in auditability.

Goal: Build a reusable Terraform module (key-federation-orchestrator) that: 1) standardizes key provisioning, 2) supports optional HSM-backed root keys, 3) provides transparent dual-write migration paths between Vault and cloud KMS, 4) exposes healthcheck endpoints and Terraform-driven canary upgrade hooks, and 5) emits telemetry and audit links for security reviews.
acceptance_criteria: Module provisions KMS keys (AWS/GCP/Azure) and registers HSM wrapped keys in Vault when hsm_enabled=true
Supports a migration mode: dual_write -> observe -> cutover with a Terraform-driven canary flag
Produces a healthcheck Terraform resource that creates an HTTP/liveness probe and a scheduled rotation-verify job
Outputs standardized data: key_arn_or_id, vault_key_path, rotation_schedule, last_rotation_timestamp
Documented upgrade/rollback plan tested in staging (runbook and automated TF plan validation)
Security review completed and audit log integration verified (CloudTrail / Vault audit backend)
Module has automated unit tests (terratest/integration) and example usage in private deployment quickstart repo
technical_notes: Module components: providers (aws/gcp/azurerm, vault), core resources (kms_key, kms_alias, vault_transit_key, vault_mount), wrapper for HSM connector: when hsm_enabled=true create external_key_binding resource pointing to HSM gateway

Dual-write migration pattern: create key in both providers, sign test vectors, verify consistent ciphertext using a migration_verify Lambda/container invoked by terraform null_resource local-exec or external provider

Health checks: create a vault/keystore-prober Kubernetes Job manifest and/or scheduledCloudFunction that performs: encrypt-decrypt roundtrip, token expiry check, and verifies HSM session establishment; expose results into CloudWatch/Stackdriver/Prometheus

Upgrade strategy: introduce feature_flag canary_percent (0-100). Terraform plan will create canary bindings and run integration tests. Rollout via incremental increases; rollback by setting canary_percent=0 and re-running plan.
Drift detection: module includes optional sentinel/opa policies and a lightweight drift-prober that compares TF state to actual key metadata and reports to ops slack channel

Secrets handling: all TF state must avoid plaintext private material. Use data sources to reference existing key material. When a new HSM-wrapped key is created, only store key reference (path/arn) not raw material.

Compatibility: module must interoperate with existing private deployment terraform root modules (private-apps/vpc-setup), expose inputs for network placement, service-account roles, and KMS IAM bindings
Testing plan: terratest scenarios for (a) fresh provision (b) dual-write migration from vault->cloud KMS (c) HSM failover where HSM gateway is stopped to verify fallback)
Performance note: rotation-verify should be non-blocking and limited to avoid hitting KMS API quotas; implement exponential backoff and batching for verification requests
comments: 2026-02-10 Aisha Patel: Initial ticket created. Spiked alternatives: a) keep separate provider modules b) build federation orchestrator. Recommendation: orchestrator for long-term consistency.

2026-02-12 Marco Rivera: Spike results attached. HSM gateway introduces latency (~120ms per wrap operation). Trade-off: require async rotation-verify job to avoid blocking infra provisioning. Will prototype a non-blocking verification step.

2026-02-15 Priya Nair (Security): Reviewed design. Request: mandate audit backends enabled and require vault_acl_policy input. Also require KMS key rotation enabled and inscope logs exported to dedicated audit account.
2026-02-18 Laila Chen (SRE): Added healthcheck requirements and SLA targets. Healthcheck must detect HSM session loss within 5 minutes and create an automated incident with runbook link.

2026-02-21 Marco Rivera: Created initial module scaffold in GH. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/private-terraform/pull/45. CI failing on terratest network mocks; assigning to Samir for test infra fixes.

2026-02-24 Samir Gupta: Test infra updated, terratest scenario 'dual-write-migration' now runs in CI with simulated KMS. Observed intermittent false negatives due to clock skew; added NTP sync step in test harness.
2026-02-28 Marco Rivera: Security review requested (tracking tag). Preparing canary rollout demo for staging on 2026-03-05. Next: finalize runbook and add sentinel policies.
